HUMAN RESOURCE MANAGEMENT AND DEVELOPMENT OFFICE 
 
November 12, 2026 
 
 
CHRISTIE JEAN VILLANUEVA-GANIERA, Ed.D., CESE 
College President 
 
SUBJECT: 
JUSTIFICATION FOR THE DELAY IN THE PROCESSING OF REIMBURSEMENT 
DOCUMENTS OF JC3 REC EVALUATION COMMITTEE MEMBERS’ ACCOMODATION 
 
Dear President Ganiera, 
 
Greetings. 
 
This is to respectfully explain the delay in the processing of the required procurement documents in connection with 
the JC3 Evaluation Activity conducted on November 9, 2026. 
 
The information from the Commission on Higher Education (CHED) regarding the accommodation requirements of 
the CHED Evaluators, who were scheduled to stay overnight on November 8 and 9, 2026, was only received by 
Doc Jovy on Friday, November 6, 2026. Unfortunately, Friday was declared a non-working day at Northern 
Bukidnon State College. As such, the necessary procurement documents could not be immediately prepared, 
processed, and facilitated upon receipt of the information. 
 
Consequently, the procurement processing was delayed due to the late receipt of information from CHED and the 
unavailability of the concerned offices during the non-working day and weekend. Ms. Noreen proceeded with the 
preparation of such documents necessary for the reimbursement of accommodation of REC Evaluators last Monday 
before the scheduled power interruption and has successfully forwarded the same to the Budget Office. However, 
upon follow up on the said documents in the following day, it was noted that the Budget Office failed to forward the 
same to the VPAF which resulted to the declination of the VPAF to accept the prepared PRs for reimbursement. 
 
In this regard, we respectfully submit this justification for consideration and understanding. We also recognize the 
importance of timely communication and coordination to ensure that procurement requirements for future 
institutional activities are submitted and processed within the prescribed timelines. 
Thank you for your kind understanding and consideration. 
 
Respectfully, 
 
RAHBIE ADAPTAR-TEOLOGO 
HRMDO Head 
 
 
Recommending Approval: 
 
JOHN KEVIN A. ARTUZ, JD, MSc 
Vice President for Administration and Finance
